name: realm-icon-src
description: The Realm app icon and the Dock alternates Settings offers. icons.mjs is the source: one vector drawing on the macOS icon grid, built from mark.svg's geometry, in nine colourings. render.mjs renders every size natively through headless Chrome and writes resources/icon.png, resources/icon.icns (iconutil) and the renderer's 256 px pictures; `--sheet <file>` draws all of them at 128 and 32 px on light and dark. vgpu and pngjs are for render-candidates.mjs / render-dock.mjs, which draw the WGSL studies in candidates/. Not part of the pnpm workspace.
